# Province scope, scope:holder must be the holder of the barony.
# Goes down the priority list. Each building the game allows here (its own
# can_construct_potential, or can_construct when there is none) and that is missing
# is built at maximum level in a free slot; when no slot is free, the worst-ranked
# building below it is removed to make room. No slot is ever added.
# Innovation requirements are deliberately ignored, as in the original mod.
mqa_b_priority_fill_province_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_building_or_higher = ramparts_01 }
			building_ramparts_requirement_terrain = yes
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots < 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = megalith_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_megalith_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = powder_magazine_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_powder_magazine_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = sacred_pool_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_sacred_pool_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = scriptorium_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_scriptorium_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = smiths_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_smiths_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = waterworks_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_waterworks_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = stilted_granaries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_stilted_granaries_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = market_villages_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_market_villages_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = quarries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_quarries_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = qanats_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_qanats_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = plantations_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_plantations_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = monastic_schools_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_monastic_schools_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = hospices_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_hospices_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = breweries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_breweries_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = workshops_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_workshops_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = spice_plantation_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_spice_plantation_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = peat_quarries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_peat_quarries_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = murex_farm_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_murex_farm_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = logging_camps_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_logging_camps_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = hill_farms_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_hill_farms_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = guild_halls_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_guild_halls_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = elephant_pens_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_elephant_pens_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = common_tradeport_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_common_tradeport_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = wind_furnace_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_wind_furnace_effect = yes

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = idjang_forts_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_idjang_forts_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = palisades_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_palisades_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = hill_forts_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_hill_forts_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = watchtowers_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_watchtowers_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = curtain_walls_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_curtain_walls_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots > 0 }
			add_building = ramparts_08
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_building_or_higher = curtain_walls_01 }
			building_curtain_walls_requirement_terrain = yes
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = waterworks_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_waterworks_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = stilted_granaries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_stilted_granaries_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots > 0 }
			add_building = market_villages_02
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_building_or_higher = stilted_granaries_01 }
			has_building_or_higher = tribe_01
			scope:holder ?= {
				government_has_flag = government_is_wanua
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots < 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = megalith_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_megalith_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = powder_magazine_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_powder_magazine_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = sacred_pool_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_sacred_pool_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = scriptorium_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_scriptorium_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = smiths_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_smiths_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = waterworks_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_waterworks_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots > 0 }
			add_building = stilted_granaries_04
		}
	}
}

# Domicile scope. Builds missing buildings in free slots, by priority: buildings with army
# bonuses first, then gold and resources, then the rest. External buildings go in the
# domicile's external slots, internal ones in the internal slots of their parent building.
# The game still checks each building's own requirements.
mqa_b_construct_domicile_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_domicile_type = camp }

			limit = {

			limit = {

				NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = supply_tent_01 }

# Domicile scope. Upgrades every domicile building one level at a time, main building
# first. Where a building can specialize, the specialization is picked by the same
# priority, then upgraded in turn.
mqa_b_upgrade_domicile_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_domicile_building = camp_main_01
		}
		add_domicile_building = camp_main_02
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_domicile_building = camp_main_02
		}
		add_domicile_building = camp_main_03
	}

			has_domicile_building = camp_main_03
		}
		add_domicile_building = camp_main_04
